items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: I remember the first couple times I heard gentlemen like Milt Hinton and Bucky and talking about the fact that they still played at weddings.

ctx.x: Yeah I think there’s different rates of compensation for different sorts of venues. You know I’ve had to raise prices just because of inflation and fortunately no one’s had a problem with that. They’re going to pay and yeah I would say so — I have different fees for different things. Like a performing arts center would be more because they have more of a budget. Private parties might be something depending on where it is and who it’s for. And there are certain things that I probably wouldn’t work below for. But…
Yeah. I remember the first couple times I heard gentlemen like Milt Hinton and Bucky and talking about the fact that they still played at weddings.
